description: This source file contains utility functions and classes related to optimizing distributed data parallel (DDP) communication operations in PyTorch using FX graph transformations and fusion strategies. It includes mechanisms for identifying communication patterns, performing fusion operations like concat and coalesced ops, scheduling wait nodes, and managing communication blocks for efficient distributed training.

classes.name: CommBlock
classes.description: A data class representing a communication block in distributed operations, encapsulating the shape, related nodes, input nodes, wait nodes, the main communication node, and output nodes involved in a collective communication pattern.

methods.name: None move_block_after(block: list[fx.Node], target_node: fx.Node)
methods.description: Reorders a list of FX nodes by appending them after a target node within the FX graph.

methods.name: None move_block_before(block: list[fx.Node], target_node: fx.Node)
methods.description: Reorders a list of FX nodes by prepending them before a target node within the FX graph.

methods.name: fx.Node call_function( graph: fx.Graph, target: str | Callable[..., Any], args: tuple[fx.node.Argument, ...] | None = None, kwargs: dict[str, fx.node.Argument] | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates a call node in the FX graph for a given function, adds fake mode processing, and annotates with tensor metadata.

methods.name: CommBlock|None get_comm_block(comm_node: fx.Node)
methods.description: Identifies and extracts a communication block (e.g., allreduce) from the FX graph given a collective node.

methods.name: list[CommBlock] get_all_comm_blocks( graph: fx.Graph, comm_ops: tuple[torch._ops.OpOverload, ...], comm_filter: Callable[..., bool] | None = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves all communication blocks from the FX graph that match specified communication operations.

methods.name: CommBlock _fuse_allreduce_by_concat( graph: fx.Graph, last_input_node: fx.Node, all_input_nodes: list[fx.Node], last_comm_block: CommBlock, )
methods.description: Fuses multiple allreduce nodes into a single concatenated allreduce operation for efficiency.

methods.name: CommBlock _fuse_with_coalesced_op( graph: fx.Graph, last_input_node: fx.Node, all_input_nodes: list[fx.Node], last_comm_block: CommBlock, )
methods.description: Fuses multiple allreduce nodes into a single coalesced operation for efficiency.

methods.name: None _scatter_fused_allreduce_waits( graph: fx.Graph, fused_comm_block: CommBlock, orig_comm_blocks: list[CommBlock], node_indices: dict[fx.Node, int], split_and_reshape: bool = True, )
methods.description: Splits the output of a fused allreduce operation to match the original individual communication nodes.

methods.name: CommBlock _fuse_allreduce( graph: fx.Graph, comm_blocks: list[CommBlock], node_indices: dict[fx.Node, int], use_concat: bool, )
methods.description: Fuses multiple allreduce communication blocks into one, using either concat or coalesced strategies.

methods.name: Generator[list[CommBlock],None,None] _bucket_size_fusion( graph: fx.Graph, comm_blocks: list[CommBlock], bucket_size_mb: int )
methods.description: Partitions communication blocks into buckets based on size constraints for batch processing.

methods.name: None _fuse_ddp_communication( graph: fx.Graph, algorithm_fn: Callable[..., Any], fusion_fn: Callable[..., Any] )
methods.description: Core logic to fuse DDP communication patterns using provided fusion and algorithm functions.

methods.name: None fuse_ddp_with_coalesced_op(graph: fx.Graph, bucket_size_mb: int)
methods.description: Fuses DDP communication blocks using coalesced operations with specified bucket size.

methods.name: None fuse_ddp_with_concat_op(graph: fx.Graph, bucket_size_mb: int)
methods.description: Fuses DDP communication blocks using concatenation with specified bucket size.

methods.name: None schedule_comm_wait(graph: fx.Graph)
methods.description: Rearranges FX graph to delay wait tensor execution until the first use, improving overlap.

methods.name: None fuse_ddp_communication( graph: fx.Graph, passes: list[Callable[..., None] | str], bucket_size_mb: int )
methods.description: Orchestrates the DDP communication fusion by applying specified passes and bucket size constraints.
